# Evidence Package: PM-11 Elicit and Analyze Requirements
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

## Evidence Summary

The original Lead Lab requirement set is well supported for recorded-session access, filtering, search, downloads, responsive access, and restricted participants. The historical sources also support administrator content publishing and participant access administration. The proposed community, classroom, calendar, and moderation features come from the new delivery plan and current conversation, but they are not yet stakeholder-validated or approved as September launch requirements.

## Candidate Requirement Classes

| Class | Candidate needs | Evidence state |
|---|---|---|
| Replacement | Recorded sessions, video playback, category/date filtering, search, materials, responsive use, restricted access | Strongly evidenced; should be confirmed for the new platform |
| Administration | Create or update session content, add video links, add materials, manage access | Strongly evidenced historically; new app workflow needs confirmation |
| Security and operations | Server-side access control, protected files, backups, monitoring, account revocation | Proposed by new plan and current risks; technical acceptance still needed |
| Community | Posts, comments, categories, pinned announcements, moderation | Proposed by new plan; not stakeholder-validated |
| Classroom | Courses, modules, lessons, and learning structure | Proposed by new plan; not stakeholder-validated |
| Calendar | Events, dates, times, descriptions, and meeting links | Proposed by new plan; not stakeholder-validated |
| Identity | Invite-only accounts, roles, and authentication | Restricted access is required; exact new-app mechanism is unresolved |
| Video protection | Limit or deter discovery/sharing of embedded video URLs | Known risk and assumption; no absolute prevention evidenced |

## Conflicts and Dependencies

| Item | Conflict or dependency | Effect on requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Platform | D-01 (self-hosted WordPress platform selection) conflicts with the proposed custom web-app direction. | Requirements must not assume the new platform is approved until the change is assessed. |
| Access | Historical SSO and Outlook-group access conflict with D-02 (native WordPress login for prototype) and the proposed invite-account model. | Access requirements need a new decision and privacy review. |
| Scope growth | D-08 (same features, no new features) remains open while community/classroom/calendar features are proposed. | PM-11 must classify these features as launch requirements, deferred enhancements, or rejected additions. |
| Content | Media team must supply video links and materials before launch. | Content requirements need a launch inventory and delivery date. |
| Infrastructure | Server runtime, database, domain, HTTPS, backups, and monitoring are unresolved for the web app. | Technical requirements cannot be baselined until environment evidence exists. |
| Video | YouTube remains the historical host, but URL sharing cannot be fully prevented. | Acceptance must define acceptable protection rather than claim secrecy. |

## Evidence Conclusion

PM-11 can produce a proposed, traceable requirements set from the available sources, but it cannot mark the new community features as verified requirements. PM-12 should define committed scope only after the PM resolves the platform direction and confirms which proposed features are required for the September launch.
